headline: KCR @ CIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is KCR 3.63 at CIN 4.75, with a projected total of 8.38. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward KCR: KCR moved -0.28 runs while CIN moved -0.82, changing the projected margin by +0.53 runs. The projected total fell -1.10, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +10.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Chase Burns has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Maikel Garcia, Spencer Steer, Bobby Witt Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Matt McLain, Tyler Tolbert because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
